text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! Winning here was my destiny,<n>and yet! Why
did my sixth sense fail<n>me?! I may have failed, but
this will<n>be a good foundation for my next win!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My next race is the 1,800-meter Rose<n>Stakes! Why,
you ask? Because I<n>need to build up more stamina
to run<n>on the deep turf found in European<n>mile
races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After the Rose Stakes, I'll be running<n>in the
2,000-meter Shuka Sho! And<n>next year, the world!
It's all coming<n>together!
